cases.input: An IVD complaint describes an unexpected positive result, but the sequence of repeat testing, specimen type and lot are incomplete. Prepare a concise follow-up that improves the investigation while the existing complaint process continues.
requiredBehaviors: link each requested fact to a concrete investigation or regulatory decision need
ask neutral factual questions about sequence specimen and lot without suggesting a cause
preserve any later response as a new evidence event rather than editing the original complaint
forbiddenBehaviors: request broad unrelated medical history merely for completeness
rewrite the original customer narrative when later information arrives

cases.input: A complaint may involve a serious false-negative result. Regulatory assessment has already been triggered, but customer service is waiting for the hospital to confirm outcome and intervention details. Build the follow-up without making the regulatory team wait.
requiredBehaviors: keep the time-critical regulatory assessment active with current facts and unknowns
request outcome and intervention details neutrally and with data minimization
represent non-response or partial response as remaining unknowns rather than negative evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: set reportability assessment to waiting solely because the hospital has not replied
interpret absence of a reply as no injury or no medical intervention
skillAnchors: Critical routing never waits for reply

cases.input: Support wants to email: 'Please confirm that user error caused the issue and that nobody was injured so we can close the case.' The prior complaint was assessed as not reportable, but a later caller mentioned emergency treatment.
requiredBehaviors: reject the leading closure-oriented questions and replace them with neutral fact requests
treat the emergency-treatment statement as a new material evidence event
route complaint reopening and jurisdiction-specific regulatory reassessment without deleting the prior decision
forbiddenBehaviors: seek customer confirmation of a preferred user-error root cause
preserve the prior not-reportable state unchanged after material new outcome information
